s1.syndrome_frame: Gastrointestinal symptoms in a patient with autoimmune disorders
salient_findings: Red streaks and slight mucosal swelling on the lesser curvature of the angle of the gastric corpus
Foveolar hyperplasia and mild degeneration of parietal cells
Mild lymphocytic infiltration and disorganized layer contours
key_facts: Patient has systemic lupus erythematosus and Sjögren’s syndrome
Patient was diagnosed with autoimmune hepatitis
Patient was scheduled for upper gastrointestinal endoscopy before starting prednisolone
Vital signs and physical examination were unremarkable
Antrum had normal appearance on endoscopy
Gastric corpus had normal coloration with a regular arrangement of collecting venules
Biopsy sites included greater curvature of the prepyloric area and lesser and greater curvatures of the gastric corpus
Histologic findings showed foveolar hyperplasia, mild degeneration of parietal cells, and mild lymphocytic infiltration
H+/K+-ATPase staining was heterogeneously reduced
Pepsinogen I staining was uneven
MUC6 staining was positive throughout the region
Chromogranin A staining showed slight enterochromaffin-like cell hyperplasia
Anti-parietal cell antibody was negative
Anti-intrinsic factor antibody was negative
Serum gastrin was within normal range
Vitamin B12 was within normal range
Anti-H. pylori IgG was negative

shortlist.label: Autoimmune gastritis

shortlist.label: Chronic atrophic gastritis
shortlist.why_kept: Histologic findings show mild degeneration of parietal cells and heterogeneously reduced H+/K+-ATPase staining

raw.rationale: The patient has Sjögren's syndrome and histologic findings show mild lymphocytic infiltration and foveolar hyperplasia, which are consistent with Sjögren's syndrome-associated gastritis.

rejected.label: Autoimmune gastritis
rejected.why: Negative anti-parietal cell antibody and normal vitamin B12 levels do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Chronic atrophic gastritis
rejected.why: Histologic findings do not show significant atrophy of the gastric mucosa

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus-associated gastritis
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence to suggest that the patient's systemic lupus erythematosus is directly causing the gastritis

rejected.label: Atrophic corpus gastritis
rejected.why: Histologic findings do not show significant atrophy of the gastric corpus
